hypothesis.trigger: V1 coarse retained evidence failed the prospective maximum-aspect-ratio gate at 16 > 12, exposed an angle-observer endpoint-selection defect, and exposed that generic steady control ignored the declared 3000-iteration stop.
hypothesis.topologyChange: Increase only the inlet/bend/outlet logical axial counts from 20/12/20 to 28/16/28; preserve the same conformal 15-block cross-section and double every logical count between grids.
hypothesis.observerCorrection: Select wall-angle endpoint candidates within 0.1% of D from the observed radial extrema so blockMesh-to-VTK interpolation noise cannot exclude the exact 0-degree endpoint. The frozen one-percent dimension gate is unchanged.
hypothesis.executionCorrection: The curved-elbow controlDict must use the prospectively declared maxIterations value of 3000 instead of the generic steady default of 2000.

claim.candidate: FlowLab can deterministically generate, execute, load, and numerically qualify one steady incompressible laminar 90-degree constant-diameter circular elbow with Rc/D=3, 10D inlet and outlet legs, and Re=100 through OpenFOAM.
claim.geometry: one canonical 90-degree circular elbow with straight inlet and outlet legs
claim.boundaryCondition: discrete-flux-normalized fully-developed parabolic velocity inlet, zero-kinematic-pressure outlet, and no-slip wall
excluded: SU2 without a supported three-dimensional result identity

refinementInterpretation.uniformLogicalRefinement: Every inlet, bend, outlet, annular-radial, circumferential, and core-side count doubles.
refinementInterpretation.geometryTreatment: Circumferential wall faceting and the piecewise-linear VTK realization refine with the solution mesh. Observed order and GCI quantify the combined solution-discretization and geometry-realization sequence, not isolated solution discretization.

observationOperators.determinism: Generate every complete case twice from the same canonical project and require identical sorted per-file SHA-256 maps.
observationOperators.geometry: Verify profile SI values, runtime VTK z span, elbow inner/outer radial bounds about the declared bend centre, straight-leg transition planes, checkMesh volume, and boundary patch counts against the frozen diameter, Rc, angle, and legs. Wall-angle endpoint candidates may be selected only within 0.1% of D from the observed radial extrema. Each declared linear or angular dimension must be within one percent; volume error is reported because faceting refines with the grid but is not substituted for the dimensional gate.
observationOperators.pressureLoss: Latest FlowLab-normalized OpenFOAM patchAverage(p) on inlet minus outlet, multiplied by densityKgPerM3 because p is kinematic pressure.
observationOperators.flowRate: Latest absolute inlet and outlet surface sums of phi; reported flow is their arithmetic mean.
observationOperators.totalPressure: At the first and last straight-leg cell-centroid planes, compute volume-weighted mean rho*(p+0.5*magSqr(U)). A negative loss larger than the prospective numerical allowance is an unexplained total-pressure gain.
observationOperators.symmetry: Pair cell-centred samples at mirrored z coordinates within identical source-cell component and streamwise planes. Compare p and the reflected velocity vector (Ux,Uy,-Uz); normalize pressure RMS by max(abs(static pressure loss), inlet dynamic pressure) and velocity RMS by mean velocity. The larger normalized error is the symmetry-plane error.
observationOperators.finiteFields: Every retained cell-centred p scalar and U vector component must be finite.
observationOperators.normalTermination: Require zero solver exit, an End marker, no fatal/non-finite marker, and either SIMPLE convergence or the exact declared iteration budget.
observationOperators.observedOrderAndGci: Three-grid Richardson extrapolation on positive static pressure loss using characteristic cell size, uniform r=2, and safety factor 1.25. Non-monotone, degenerate, or otherwise invalid sequences are unqualified.

provenanceRequirements: clean committed source identity for every transitive scientific path
generated case manifest and per-file SHA-256
explicit source-cell component ranges for inlet-leg, elbow, and outlet-leg
Docker image tag and immutable image ID
JobManager record, command, exit code, and timestamps
per-iteration inlet and outlet pressure and flow histories
per-level evaluation and three-level qualification report

retention.gitAdmission: Raw runs remain local. Only separately reviewed compact artifacts explicitly allowlisted in benchmarks/tracked-evidence.txt may be force-added.
